component.name: Bing-r
component.summary: A modern desktop IPTV and media player

description.p: Bingr is a high-performance desktop media client for Live TV, VOD, library management, and playback. Import M3U playlists, browse channels by category and country, and watch with hardware-accelerated mpv playback.

ul.li: M3U playlist import from files and URLs
Channel browsing with category and country filters
Dark theme with modern Qt Quick UI

description.p: Flatpak packaging and home screen improvements.
